name: CheckpointObby
brief: An obby with a checkpoint: start floor with SpawnLocation, 3 platforms, a checkpoint pad, 3 more platforms, then a finish pad. Touching the checkpoint makes the player respawn there after dying.
contract: Create a SpawnLocation on the start floor inside script.Parent.
Name the 6 platforms Stage1 ... Stage6 in jump order; the checkpoint pad is a Part named Checkpoint between Stage3 and Stage4; the finish pad is Goal.
After a player touched Checkpoint, every respawn of that player must put the character on the Checkpoint (for example in CharacterAdded, move the character there).
